subject: Request: Short-term allowance for semester LLM pilot (grant deadline looming)
messages:
From: Dr. Emily Stokes <emily.stokes@greenvalley.edu>
To: rachel.kim@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 8 May 2028 16:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Request for additional short-term allowance for semester pilot

Hi Rachel,

Hope you’re well — I’m Emily Stokes, assistant professor in the CS department at Green Valley University. We started the LLM-backed writing-assistant pilot with Redwood last month, but onboarding delays and an expanded student cohort mean we’re going to run out of our trial credits before the semester project concludes.

Our grant application that funds the remainder of the pilot is due next Friday (May 12). If we can secure a small bridge/top-up (40k token-equivalent) to carry the pilot through the evaluation period, that would make our application much stronger and allow us to present full results.

Quick context:
- Course: COMP 420 — NLP in Practice (senior undergrads, 60 students)
- Current usage: prompted eval + student assistants; roughly 30k tokens/week historically, ramping up to ~45k/week this month
- Sought top-up: ~40k tokens (estimate attached)

Can you advise on whether Redwood offers short-term allowances or expedited promotional credits for verified academic pilots? We’d be grateful for anything you can do. Our procurement team will follow up for PO/contract if needed.

Attachments: GVU_syllabus.pdf (overview), grant-supporting-docs.zip (including project budget excerpt)

Thanks —Emily

Dr. Emily Stokes
Assistant Professor, Computer Science
Green Valley University
emily.stokes@greenvalley.edu
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Dr. Emily Stokes <emily.stokes@greenvalley.edu>
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 8 May 2028 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request for additional short-term allowance for semester pilot

Hi Emily — thanks for the clear note and the attachments. I’m looping in Monica (Customer Success) and Vivek (Grants & Special Programs) to evaluate a short-term bridge. Monica — can you confirm the current usage/remaining credits? Vivek — do we have a precedent for academic bridge allowances for grant timing issues?

If possible, please include a one-paragraph expected deliverable summary and a single-line PO timeline so we can expedite internal approvals. I’ll track this on our side to meet the May 12 grant deadline.

Rachel Kim
Enterprise Accounts
Redwood Inference

Thanks Rachel — quick internal note: I pulled the tenant usage for GVU and confirmed they have ~12% of trial credits left (historical burn matches Emily’s estimate). If we provide a provisional top-up of 40k token-equivalent that should cover May evaluation runs and the final student project submissions.

A few operational asks before I approve from CS side:
- Can Emily confirm expected start date for additional tokens and whether the students will use streaming endpoints (affects burst/cost)?
- Do they require expanded retention/audit logs for IRB? That could change the configuration.

Attachment: usage_estimate.csv (internal calc)

If procurement needs an invoice/PO, we’ll need a nominal cost line for accounting. Vivek — your call on waiving the fee or approving a discounted academic allowance.

Hi Monica / Rachel / Vivek — thanks for the quick response. Short answers:
- Start date: as soon as approved (we plan a benchmarking run Thursday, May 10)
- End date: final deliverable due May 20
- Endpoints: primarily standard text-gen endpoint (no streaming), small batch inference from student submissions — spikes but short-lived
- IRB/retention: we have IRB approval; no special retention beyond default university policy
- Procurement: procurement@greenvalley.edu can sign a nominal PO within 48 hours if Redwood provides a simple quote line for the top-up.

I’ve attached a small CSV with an hourly-run sketch and the minimum token buffer we’d need for the grant appendix. If you can provide an expedited provisional allowance (or a discounted invoice we can include in the application), that will be a big help.

Attachment: usage_estimate.csv (pilot estimate)

Best,
Emily
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>

Cc: Dr. Emily Stokes <emily.stokes@greenvalley.edu>, Green Valley University - Procurement <procurement@greenvalley.edu>
Date: Wed, 9 May 2028 12:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request for additional short-term allowance for semester pilot

Thanks, team. I’m approving a provisional academic allowance of up to 40,000 token-equivalent for Green Valley University to bridge to their grant decision. Conditions:
- This is a one-time provisional allowance expiring 2028-05-21.
- Procurement should issue a nominal PO within 72 hours endorsing the usage; if no PO is received we convert to a discounted invoice for the grant (accounting follow-up).
- Customer must confirm that no streaming endpoints will be used (monitored by CS).

Rachel/Monica — I’ll create the approval artifact and attach it here. Monica, please proceed with enabling the buffer and monitoring burn rate; alert me if usage exceeds 75% of the allowance early.

Regards,
Vivek Kulkarni
Grants & Special Programs
Redwood Inference
